acceptanceCriteria: A post-run observation at load ~60 on a 12-core darwin host completes within the production bound with measured headroom (counts and loads recorded).
Any bound or budget change carries owner-accepted GLTP-V0-027/041 amendments; the GLTP-V0-041 fixture passes rather than skipping INCONCLUSIVE at load 40-65.
body: Measured in the V1-1420 lane (PR #928, BASE 6457b86bc, darwin go1.27.2, 12 cores): at load 49-65 the GOROOT walk took 7.7-21.1 s and a whole observation 10.6-25.4 s; at load 37-44 all three post-run calls hit the 15 s deadline. The postAuthorityTimeout comment claiming 15 s is large enough on a cold filesystem is refuted. PR #928 added a test-only seam; production is unchanged. Options: cheaper/cached GOROOT identity, parallel hashing, or a raised bound; raising the bound or changing the GLTP-V0-041 fixture budget amends GLTP-V0-027/041: owner decision.
title: liveverify parent verifier re-hashes all of GOROOT (270 MB, 15,588 files) single-threaded per authority call; 15 s postAuthorityTimeout too tight under load
